blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Akbayan Rep. Percival Cendaña scored his fellow lawmakers for slighting budget watchdogs in this year’s budget review cycle as the House of Representatives moves forward in the process, saying the chamber seemingly made a “U-turn” amid spending discussions for 2027. A minority lawmaker, Cendaña questioned why civil society organizations (CSO) were left out in the first weeks of budget talks, blocking their access to discussions despite sweeping reforms enacted last year to soothe outcry against so-called congressional insertions in the spending plan. “It seems that while we were driving towards the right direction, this year, it appeared we […]...
